detail.longDescription: I need this built into the OS too! Every time I turn it on/wake it up after [time] – before I can interact with anything else – I need to be greeted by a fullscreen list of todo items (preferably from my default todo app). To go any further I'll have to select [#] of items from that list, which I shall work on during this session of my PC time. The selected items needs to then always be on my screen in some way, as a reminder+checklist. # ScreenTime # productivity # intention # linux # kde # gnome
